name: Vehicle Rental Additional Amount 1

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Code that describes the type of amount or fee. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

CreditDebit.name: Credit Debit
CreditDebit.definition: Indicates whether or not the amount is a credit or debit.

CustomerNotified.name: Customer Notified
CustomerNotified.definition: Indicates whether or not the customer was notified about additional amounts.
